name: nocturnes-oblivion-destroys-a-non-champion-object-and-banishes-itself
notes: Nocturne's Oblivion: destroy target non-champion object, then banish Nocturne's Oblivion. It used to stay in the graveyard.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Nocturne's Oblivion's "Banish CARDNAME" used the variable mzID (the effect-stack slot) to find itself, but by the time a spell's effect runs it has already moved from the stack to the graveyard, so it was never banished and stayed in the graveyard. Fix: it is looked up in the graveyard (BanishResolvedSpellFromGraveyard).
